note: Jesus came into the world through a real family, so he understands what your life is actually like.
He was willing to suffer on the cross because he already loved you before you were even born.
The whole point of this book is to point you back to him, so reading it is never wasted time.
No matter what you are carrying, there is a way through it, and it runs through him.
Your effort matters, but his grace is what carries you the rest of the way.
Just keep walking toward him one day at a time and that is enough.
The God of the universe chose to come down and live among ordinary people, which means he is not out of reach.
His name is the one name strong enough to save you, and he offers it freely.
He did not send someone else to redeem you, he came himself.
Death does not get the last word, because he already broke its grip.
However far off course you feel, his power is enough to turn you all the way around.
He is the Lamb who takes away the weight of sin so you do not have to carry it alone.
He felt pain and sickness himself so he could understand yours completely.
When you are struggling, he is not watching from a distance, he already knows how it feels.
Nothing in your life is too costly for him to cover, because he already paid the greatest price.
His atonement is big enough for every single person, including you.
In your lowest moment, just remembering his name can be the turning point.
Calling out to Jesus in your pain is not weakness, it is exactly what he wants you to do.
There is no better foundation to build your life on than him.
He keeps his word, and you can trust what he has promised you too.
He already suffered for everything you are going through, so you never face it truly alone.
He took on the weight of the world so you could set your own weight down.
He is moved by compassion when he sees you hurting, not annoyed by your need.
He simply asks you to remember him, which is something you can do every single day.
He has not changed, so the same love and power he showed back then is available to you right now.
Your weaknesses are not disqualifying, they are actually where his strength shows up best.
Hope in him is not naive, it is a steady anchor even when things feel uncertain.
Ask for his kind of love and let it soften how you see other people.
Coming to him does not require you to be finished, it just requires you to start.
His grace is what fills in the gaps between who you are and who you are becoming.
